moments.title: Halloween Weekend is Here!
moments.blurb: The spookiest weekend of the year kicks off, with Halloween falling on Saturday, October 31st, bringing fright nights, parties, and family events across the UK.

angles.name: UK-wide Scarefests
angles.copy: Get ready for a fright! Theme parks like Alton Towers, Thorpe Park, and Warwick Castle are going all out with their Scarefests and Haunted Castles until November 1st. What's your favourite spooky attraction?

angles.name: Local Halloween Fun
angles.copy: From Calan Gaeaf at Dinefwr to Ffear Fforest at Zip World, Wales is buzzing with Halloween activities this weekend. Don't miss the Halloween Nights at St Fagans or the Steam & Scream trains!

angles.name: Exeter Spooks
angles.copy: Exeter's getting spooky! From Silent Discos at the Museum to various club nights, there are plenty of ways to celebrate Halloween in Devon this weekend. What are your plans?

moments.title: Premier League Showdowns
moments.blurb: Matchweek 9 of the Premier League kicks off this Saturday with big clashes including Chelsea v Man Utd and Tottenham v Crystal Palace, followed by Liverpool v Arsenal on Sunday.

angles.name: Saturday Fixtures
angles.copy: Premier League action is back! Saturday sees Chelsea take on Man Utd at 12:30, Spurs host Crystal Palace at 17:30, and Aston Villa face Fulham at 20:00. Who are you backing?

angles.name: Sunday Big Game
angles.copy: Sunday's a big one! Liverpool clash with Arsenal at 16:30 in a crucial top-of-the-table encounter. Tune in for all the build-up!

moments.title: Bonfire Night is Next Week
moments.blurb: Guy Fawkes Night is on Thursday, November 5th, with many firework displays and bonfires planned for the surrounding weekend of November 7th and 8th across the UK.

angles.name: Get Ready for Sparks
angles.copy: Remember, remember, the 5th of November! Bonfire Night is just around the corner. Many spectacular firework displays are planned for the weekend of 7th-8th November. Where will you be watching from?

angles.name: London Fireworks
angles.copy: London's skies will light up for Bonfire Night! Look out for events at Ally Pally, Battersea Park, and Wimbledon Park over the weekend of Nov 7/8.

angles.name: Exeter's Display
angles.copy: Exeter's 'Galactic Skies Charity Fireworks and Drone Event' is set for November 7th! Get ready for a spectacular show for a good cause.

moments.title: Latest UK Singles Chart Hits
moments.blurb: The Official UK Singles Chart for the week ending October 29, 2026, sees Sam Fender & Olivia Dean at Number 1 with 'Rein Me In,' alongside other popular tracks.

angles.name: Chart Toppers
angles.copy: Fresh from the Official UK Singles Chart! Sam Fender & Olivia Dean are at Number 1 with 'Rein Me In'. What's your favourite track from the latest Top 10?

angles.name: New Entries & Movers
angles.copy: Ella Langley's 'Choosin' Texas' and RAYE's 'Where Is My Husband!' are still making waves in the Top 10 this week. Who else is dominating the airwaves?

moments.title: ABBA Voyage Continues in London
moments.blurb: The groundbreaking ABBA Voyage concert experience continues its run at the custom-built ABBA Arena in London, offering fans a unique digital performance.

angles.name: Experiencing ABBA
angles.copy: Still haven't been to ABBA Voyage? The incredible digital concert experience is still dazzling audiences at the ABBA Arena in London. It's the closest thing to time travel!

angles.name: Timeless Pop
angles.copy: Waterloo, Dancing Queen, Mamma Mia... ABBA's hits are timeless. Catch the magic of ABBA Voyage in London if you can!

moments.title: Steven Wilson at Royal Albert Hall
moments.blurb: Progressive rock artist Steven Wilson concludes his two-night residency at the Royal Albert Hall in London tonight, October 29th.

angles.name: Prog Rock Live
angles.copy: Tonight's the last chance to catch Steven Wilson at the iconic Royal Albert Hall! What an incredible two nights for prog rock fans in London.

moments.title: The Cinematic Orchestra at St. Paul's Cathedral
moments.blurb: The Cinematic Orchestra performs a special show at St. Paul's Cathedral in London tonight, October 29th.

angles.name: Unique Venue Gig
angles.copy: Tonight in London: The Cinematic Orchestra play a unique show at the magnificent St. Paul's Cathedral. What an atmosphere that will be!

moments.title: James Blake's 'Trying Times' Tour in Bristol
moments.blurb: James Blake concludes his two-night 'Trying Times' UK tour stop in Bristol tonight, October 29th.

angles.name: Bristol's Electronic Sound
angles.copy: Bristol fans, it's your last chance to see James Blake on his 'Trying Times' tour tonight! His immersive electronic sound live is not to be missed.

moments.title: Huey Morgan in Exeter Tonight
moments.blurb: Huey Morgan of Fun Lovin' Criminals brings his Autumn Tour to Exeter Phoenix tonight, October 29th.

angles.name: Fun Lovin' Night
angles.copy: Exeter! Huey Morgan is at Exeter Phoenix tonight for his Autumn Tour. Get ready for some Fun Lovin' Criminals classics and more!

moments.title: Happy 65th to Randy Jackson
moments.blurb: Randy Jackson, the youngest brother of The Jackson 5, celebrates his 65th birthday today!

angles.name: Jackson 5 Memories
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 65th birthday to Randy Jackson! From The Jackson 5 to solo success, he's been a part of music history.

moments.title: Melba Moore Turns 81
moments.blurb: Legendary R&B and Broadway singer Melba Moore celebrates her 81st birthday today.

angles.name: R&B Icon
angles.copy: Happy 81st birthday to the incredible Melba Moore! A true icon of R&B and Broadway. What's your favourite Melba Moore track?

moments.title: Roger O'Donnell is 71
moments.blurb: Roger O'Donnell, keyboardist for The Cure, celebrates his 71st birthday today.

angles.name: The Cure's Keys
angles.copy: Happy 71st birthday to Roger O'Donnell, the brilliant keyboardist for The Cure! What's your favourite Cure song?

moments.title: Fleur East Turns 39
moments.blurb: Singer, rapper, and presenter Fleur East celebrates her 39th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Fleur
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 39th birthday to the fantastic Fleur East! From X Factor to radio and TV, she's always entertaining.

moments.title: Blue Lights Season 4 Finale Approaches
moments.blurb: The acclaimed BBC police drama 'Blue Lights' Season 4, which premiered on September 29th with a full box set on iPlayer, airs its final weekly episodes through November 3rd.

angles.name: Last Call for Blue Lights
angles.copy: Have you been gripped by 'Blue Lights' Season 4? The critically acclaimed police drama airs its final weekly episodes this week, concluding its run by November 3rd. Catch up on iPlayer!

moments.title: New Spy Docuseries on BBC Select
moments.blurb: A new docuseries, 'Wonderland: Secrets of the Spymasters & Spies Season 1,' premieres today, October 29th, on BBC Select.

angles.name: Spy Secrets Revealed
angles.copy: Intrigued by the world of espionage? 'Wonderland: Secrets of the Spymasters & Spies Season 1' premieres today on BBC Select, delving into the world of spymasters.

moments.title: Exeter Chiefs in Premiership Rugby
moments.blurb: Exeter Chiefs play Sale Sharks at home in Premiership Rugby on Saturday, October 31st at 3 PM.

angles.name: Chiefs Home Game
angles.copy: Big game for Exeter Chiefs this Saturday! They take on Sale Sharks at Sandy Park in Premiership Rugby at 3 PM. Get behind the lads!

moments.title: Premiership Rugby: Bristol vs Leicester
moments.blurb: Bristol Bears host Leicester Tigers in Premiership Rugby tomorrow, October 30th, at 7:45 PM.

angles.name: Friday Night Rugby
angles.copy: Premiership Rugby action tomorrow night! Bristol Bears clash with Leicester Tigers at 7:45 PM. Who's taking the win?
